# Author recording handoff

Record `reading-script.md` for the complete chapter, or the named `*-script.md` for a specific cut. The complete script is byte-identical to the approved manuscript, including the authorized title. Each cut script contains exact original excerpts in visual order.

Deliver an unprocessed mono WAV, preferably 48 kHz / 24 bit, with a few seconds of room tone. Record at a natural pace; the 15/45/60/150-second edit timings are placeholders, not a speaking-speed requirement. Supply takes with the cut name and take number.

On receipt: align takes to the storyboard, extend or shorten scene holds, replace the provisional text timings with speech-aligned Vietnamese SRT/VTT, duck the ambient bed under speech, check on headphones and a phone, then export the final mix. English subtitle translation remains a later editorial pass.

`ambience.wav` is a generated tonal room bed, 24 seconds at 24 kHz mono. Video loops this bed with fades; it contains no voice, sampled music or film soundtrack. Narration has not been generated. No tile/page Foley is claimed.
